items.title: Is AI Making Us Worse at Cybersecurity?
items.summary: Overreliance on AI could erode the creativity, clear communication, and critical thinking security teams need when there’s no playbook. The post Is AI Making Us Worse at Cybersecurity? appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Attackers Exploit UnrealIRCd Flaw That Enables Server-Level Command Injection
items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a high-severity security flaw impacting UnrealIRCd, an open-source Internet Relay Chat (IRC) server, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-114713 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of improper neutralization of delimiters

items.summary: The tech giant has detailed the architecture designed to isolate ambient sensor data from the main OS on HomeView and new iPhones. The post Apple Reveals How Secure Exclaves Shield Camera and Microphone Data appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: No Signs of Hacking in FAA Ground Stop as FBI Reportedly Probes Software Update
items.summary: Officials say there is no evidence of a cyberattack behind the nationwide FAA outage, which may have been caused by a software update. The post No Signs of Hacking in FAA Ground Stop as FBI Reportedly Probes Software Update appeared first on SecurityWeek .
